name: Trusted Semiconductor Solutions
old_description: Microelectronics development from concept to qualified part delivery
about:
Trusted Semiconductor Solutions was founded in 2006 and is based in Brooklyn Park, Minnesota. The company operates as a small business concern and non‑traditional defense contractor with DoD Category 1A Trusted Accreditation. No individual founders are named in the public materials.

The firm functions as a fabless semiconductor design and product development house, specializing in radiation‑hardened microelectronics. Its service portfolio covers analog/mixed‑signal and ASIC/SoC design, semiconductor IP development, chiplet and high‑density package design, wafer foundry coordination, package assembly, test and screening, printed circuit board design, and procurement services. The engineering staff includes IC design and verification engineers, analog/mixed‑signal/digital IP designers, package designers, board designers, and system engineers. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Trusted Semiconductor Solutions serves aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, avionics, military, and space markets. Its microelectronics enable next‑generation systems as well as sustainment of mission‑critical platforms, including legacy part replacement for obsolete commercial‑off‑the‑shelf components.

The company differentiates itself through its fabless model, which provides access to state‑of‑the‑practice (45 nm and above) and state‑of‑the‑art (sub‑28 nm) foundry technologies such as CMOS, SOI, FinFET, SiGe, BiCMOS, bipolar, and gate‑all‑around processes. It positions itself as a single point of contact from design through delivery, offering program management, consulting, and customer service.
